sections.title: Opening Editorial Hero
sections.headline: I am the customer you're trying to retain.
sections.subhead: And I understand the technology, data, and experiences that make her come back.

sections.title: Competitive Intelligence
sections.subtitle: From Viral Product to Daily Ritual
sections.features: Interactive brand selector (Arrae vs Lemme vs Cymbiotika), side-by-side customer journey comparison, verified vs hypothesis tags, strategic insights card

sections.title: Cohort Intelligence Lab
sections.subtitle: Interactive Analysis of 2,000+ Synthetic Customer Profiles
sections.interactive: Clickable cohort rows opening detailed drawer with 'What the Data Is Telling Us' strategic breakdown

sections.title: Subscription Rescue Studio
sections.features: Cancellation reason picker, Original (friction-heavy) vs Improved (Value-first rescue) flow interactive simulator with phone mockup, key hypothesis, expected churn reduction % and saved revenue metric

sections.title: Email & SMS Lifecycle Studio
sections.features: 9 key retention journeys, filterable by Trigger / Segment / Channel / Timing / Messaging. Realistic desktop email preview + mobile SMS preview. Persona switcher (Sensory-first, Routine Builder, Value Seeker). Interactive A/B test builder with copy/timing toggle

sections.title: Experimentation Engine
sections.features: 4 strategic experiments with ICE (Impact, Confidence, Ease) sliders. Dynamic priority matrix recalculation and impact timeline visualization

sections.title: CLV Simulator
sections.features: Interactive financial model with input sliders (AOV, Purchase Frequency, Retention Rate, Margin %, Discount Rate). Baseline vs Scenario comparison with live ROI and mathematical formulas visible

sections.title: HCI Lab — Portal UX Redesign
sections.features: Interactive toggle between Standard Recharge Portal vs Improved Arrae Custom Portal. Visual annotations highlighting micro-copy, delay options, swap mechanisms, and gift unlocks

sections.title: About Hamda
sections.headline: Part wellness consumer. Part technologist. Entirely curious about why people stay.
sections.features: Editorial profile with photo placeholder frame, core operating principles, background in retention engineering & product strategy

sections.title: 90-Day Retention Roadmap & Methodology
sections.closing_line: Acquisition starts the relationship. Experience determines whether it lasts.
sections.features: Interactive 90-day execution Gantt/phase roadmap (Days 1-30, 31-60, 61-90) + Methodology section detailing data synthetic engine parameters and research framework

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette: Warm ivory (#FDFBF7) background, deep espresso (#1C1817) typography, with accents of soft butter yellow (#FAF2D6), pale blush (#F7E5DE), and muted sage (#E3E8E0 / #6A7B68).
Use Cormorant Garamond for all section titles and editorial hero headings. Use Plus Jakarta Sans for UI elements, labels, and dashboard controls.
Ensure all 10 required sections are built completely as interactive client-side React components in src/App.js or dedicated sub-components.
Include data-testid on all key interactive elements (buttons, filter selects, tabs, sliders, charts, links) using kebab-case role-based names.
Ensure smooth scrolling between sticky navigation links and page sections using scroll-margin-top / scroll-smooth.
Use Recharts or SVG charts styled in muted sage and terracotta tones for the Cohort Intelligence Lab and CLV Simulator.
Add explicit Independent Concept label in the top navigation bar or header to indicate candidacy proposal.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use dark gradients or pure black (#000000). Use deep espresso (#1C1817) for dark text.
Avoid generic centered layouts or corporate Vercel/Stripe card aesthetic.
All buttons must have hover, active, and focus states with subtle scale or background hue transitions.
Ensure containers with borders have explicit internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to avoid collision.
DO NOT use raw HTML select or standard input where custom styled select or sliders enhance editorial feel.
Include toast feedback via Sonner for actions like saving A/B tests, applying filters, or copying strategic takeaways.
